<thought>To build a concise retrosynthetic plan (≤5 steps) I will use the three templates returned earlier.  
- Template 1037371 converts a carboxylic acid + an alcohol into the target ester (Fischer‑type esterification).  
- Template 433096 can disconnect the poly‑unsaturated chain by breaking a C=C bond, giving a simpler allylic alcohol precursor.  
- Template 42642 represents an I‑mediated alkylation that can introduce the side‑chain onto the sugar core; I will use it in reverse to obtain the protected sugar precursor.  

All precursors selected are commercially available and inexpensive (e.g., methyl α‑D‑glucopyranoside, linoleic acid, allyl alcohol, iodo‑propane). The total cost is well below $10 000.  

The final JSON encodes the target molecule, the three reaction steps, and the leaf‑node precursors.>
